snippet.title: BeastLink: Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get your stomping shoes ready as the multiplayer kaiju-battling game BeastLink prepares to launch into Steam Early Access on August 18. If you see it, you can wreck it. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962780/BeastLink/
